notes.title: Now Available on Steam - 99 Levels To Hell
notes.notes:
99 Levels To Hell is Now Available on Steam!

99 Levels to Hell is a platform shooter with lots of guns, upgrades, magic, traps and monsters to kill. It's is a rogue-like, which means surviving is key and every time you play you get a new set of levels to play. When you complete 10 levels, the 10th being a boss-fight you unlock a door to the next dungeon.

Hidden in the darkness of the dungeons are shops, casinos and elevators. And if you search the dungeons carefully, you might find secret rooms that unlock more of the story, and free new adventurers, you can play as in your next game.

The Soundtrack is also available.

notes.title: Bugs
notes.notes:
So, if you find a bug, and want me to take a look at it, here's how you do :)

First check the forum for similar bug reports before posting. Someone may already have found a solution you can use.

If there does not yet seem to be a fix for the bug you encountered, go ahead and make a post oin this thread, with the description of the bug. 

For me to be most effective in finding and correcting the bugs, here's what I need info on:

---

Platform: The platform is the system you were playing on: PC/Mac/Linux

Hardware: What kind of CPU anf GPU are you using. How much memory does your system have?

Description: A relatively detailed explanation of how the bug happened. Tell us what happened and where it happened.

Pics: If you have relevant screenshots or video of the bug, I'd love to have a look.

How to replicate: A short description of the events and actions leading up to the bug and if you are able to replicate the bug consistantly (ie. does it happen every time, sometimes or just once)

---

The more info you give me, the easier it is for me to sort out the bugs :)

Cheers!

/Bo

notes.title: Steam Keys
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.
A lot people has been asking about Steam keys.
So to break it down, it works like this. If you have the game on Desura or have a Desura key from a bundle you can get a Free Steam Key.

All you have to do is redeem your Desura key on Desura and go to http://www.desura.com/collection and get you your Steam key. This won't work till the game is released, so check Steam to see if the game is available first. 

Hope this clarifies things a bit :)
